notes.title: Official Release
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the official release of O.W.L Projekt! In this 3D isometric puzzle, you take control of Elysion, a character with unique abilities, embarking on a journey filled with logic and strategy challenges to escape the enigmatic Watchers and master each level. Every detail has been carefully crafted to offer a challenging and captivating experience.

We invite everyone to play O.W.L Projekt and share your thoughts! Your feedback is essential for us to keep improving the game and offering the best experience possible. Good luck, and we can’t wait to hear what you think! 🦉

notes.title: Live Gameplay - O.W.L Projekt: Unraveling Secrets and Escaping the Watchers!
notes.content:
Get ready for a mysterious journey in the world of O.W.L Projekt, a 3D isometric puzzle game that will challenge your mind and logical skills! In this live stream, we’ll step into the shoes of Elysion, a young individual created in a secret experiment, on a mission to escape the enigmatic Watchers and uncover the mysteries behind the project that gave him life.

Armed with the powerful Sanctum Staff, Elysion can manipulate objects and overcome complex obstacles while exploring 50 meticulously designed levels filled with innovative puzzles and increasing challenges. Discover hidden passages, move platforms and blocks with finesse, and face new enigmas at every level!

What to expect from the live:

[list]
[*] Unique and innovative puzzle mechanics
[*] Challenging levels with progressive difficulty
[*] An intriguing story filled with mysteries
[*] Charming visuals in a 3D isometric environment
[/list]

Are you ready to test your mind and help Elysion escape the Watchers? Join us for this thrilling live stream and see if you can unravel all the secrets of O.W.L Projekt!

You're invited to chill with us! 
Don't forget to play the demo too!
Please, consider add the game to your Wishlist :)
